environment.description: Same ECS Fargate service and code deployed identically. Two infrastructure-level controls are active in combination: (1) The RDS PostgreSQL instance uses a custom parameter group where 'pgaudit.log' is set to 'all' and critically, the database role 'app_svc' has ROW LEVEL SECURITY policies enforced via ALTER TABLE documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; with policy: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid); The application sets this via SET LOCAL app.current_tenant before each query block (connection pooler pgbouncer in transaction mode ensures isolation). (2) The 'app_svc' role is configured with a SECURITY LABEL restricting DML to only parameterized prepared statements via the pg_query_rewrite extension: any query containing string literal concatenation patterns in WHERE clauses against the 'documents' table that doesn't match registered prepared statement signatures is rejected with ERROR at the planner stage. The extension uses a whitelist of query hashes registered at deploy time.

config.db_user_grants: SELECT ON documents (via RLS), INSERT, UPDATE restricted by RLS
config.session_variable_injection: SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = $tenant_id executed by connection middleware before each transaction
